Author: dongkyeomjang <jangelliot0404@dgu.ac.kr>
Date:   Fri Oct 16 21:10:13 2026 +0900

    Check external credit before loans and expose loan details
    
    Loans now call the credit check port before the book is lent. A rejected
    check returns 409 CREDIT_REJECTED and leaves the book unchanged; a failed
    check returns 503 CREDIT_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE. The check result is stored
    with the loan, and GET /loans/{loanId} returns it.
    
    The vendor SDK (com.examplecredit.sdk) is included unmodified. Only
    adapter.out.credit touches it, so the real server can replace the bean
    in CreditCheckConfig.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit 6a8bd1c5df2f68fe9e6dd88d89dbd146a24fc386
Author: dongkyeomjang <jangelliot0404@dgu.ac.kr>
Date:   Fri Oct 16 21:07:27 2026 +0900

    Add book reservations with a per-book queue
    
    - POST /books/{bookId}/reservations queues a member behind a loaned book and returns reservationId and position (1-based)
    - Reserving an available book returns 409 BOOK_AVAILABLE; a discarded book returns 409 BOOK_DISCARDED
    - A member can hold only one place in a book's queue (409 ALREADY_RESERVED)
    - After a return, only the head of the queue can loan the book; others get 409 RESERVED_FOR_OTHER
    - Borrowing by the head consumes that reservation; books with no reservations behave as before
    - GET /books/{bookId}/reservations lists the remaining reservations in queue order
    - Return locks the book row so a return and a reservation cannot interleave on the same book
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

    Add book reservations with a per-book queue
    
    - POST /books/{bookId}/reservations queues a member behind a loaned book and returns reservationId and position (1-based)
    - Reserving an available book returns 409 BOOK_AVAILABLE; a discarded book returns 409 BOOK_DISCARDED
    - A member can hold only one place in a book's queue (409 ALREADY_RESERVED)
    - After a return, only the head of the queue can loan the book; others get 409 RESERVED_FOR_OTHER
    - Borrowing by the head consumes that reservation; books with no reservations behave as before
    - GET /books/{bookId}/reservations lists the remaining reservations in queue order
    - Return locks the book row so a return and a reservation cannot interleave on the same book

content.text:
`GET /members/{memberId}/loans/history` is in place and committed as `58556d3`. `./gradlew build` passes, including 4 new tests in `LendingIntegrationTest`.

Each item has `loanId`, `title`, `loanedAt`, `returnedAt` and `lateFee`. Loans not yet returned have `returnedAt` and `lateFee` as `null`. A member with no loans gets `[]`.

Choices I made that you may want to change:

- **Unknown member returns 404**, the same as the existing active-loans endpoint. Your spec didn't cover this case.
- **No paging.** You asked for the full history, so the endpoint returns everything. If members can accumulate hundreds of loans, paging would be a follow-up.
- **Same-day loans are ordered by `id` descending.** Loan IDs are random UUIDs, so among loans taken on the same day the order is stable but not chronological. Adding a sequence column would fix that if it matters.
- **The late-fee formula moved into the domain** as `Loan.lateFeeOf(dueAt, returnedAt)`, so the history query can compute the fee without rebuilding a `Loan`. The existing `Loan.lateFee()` is unchanged and the 100-won-per-day rule is still in one place.

The new code follows the layers in `CLAUDE.md`: a new output port, a JPA projection query, a service, and a response record. The controller only maps the result.
